scope: Bound graphics-adapter disambiguation only. CNWCObject+0x78 forwarded slots have incompatible signatures with the verified primary Gob vtable; they are not resolved merely by assigning primary Gob method names.
disproved_hypothesis: Using 0x140d814a0 as a Gob vtable origin incorrectly aligned its shadow methods with +0x130/+0x138. That location is inside a different table. Actual Gob shadow methods are +0x190/+0x198.

Regex mode uses Java Pattern semantics. Matcher or compiler stack exhaustion returns a resource constraint without closing the session; literal mode avoids regex recursion and returns complete matching values.
